Defunct functions

Source: R/visgen.R, R/visnetwork.R
rvis-defunct.Rd

These functions are no longer supported and only stop with an error naming their replacement. They are kept so that old code calling them gets a clear message.

  • verifyPlotInputs(): replaced by the internal functions prepareAesthetics() and prepare4Plot() used by all wrappers.

  • visNetwork.graphChart(): replaced by rvisPlot("graph", "visNetwork", ...).

Usage

visNetwork.graphChart(
  nodes,
  links,
  size = NULL,
  sizeLegend = NULL,
  shape = NULL,
  shapeLegend = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  colorLegend = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  linkColor = NULL,
  linkLength = NULL,
  linkLengthLegend = NULL,
  linkSource = NULL,
  linkTarget = NULL,
  linkWidth = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

obj, x, y, z, t, color, size, shape, label, labelColor, theta, linkSource, linkTarget, tooltip, palette.color, palette.labelColor, nodes, links, sizeLegend, shapeLegend, colorLegend, linkColor, linkLength, linkLengthLegend, linkWidth, ...

Ignored.
